notes: The calendar now works in short cards. Before, a card under 200px tall could only ever show a week; now it shows as much calendar as it has room for.
Three rows high shows the whole month. Two rows shows the month name above its week. One row shows the date.
A single small square is left empty on purpose -- all that fits there is a date line, and the clock already draws one.
A wide card holding a week is no longer refused. The old rule measured the shape of the box; it now measures whether the seven days still read as a week, which is what the rule was always about.
